metadata.description: SoraLabs skills: animating-icons (SVG icon gestures) and motion-meaning (prefers-reduced-motion so meaning survives).

plugins.name: animating-icons
plugins.description: Author, review, or batch-produce hover animations for SVG icons. Twelve gesture families, a seventeen-item failure catalog, the vector-morph correspondence method, the three-line icon-to-icon morph system, and a verification harness that measures instead of eyeballing.

plugins.name: motion-meaning
plugins.description: Classify UI motion as communicative or decorative, then fix or apply prefers-reduced-motion so meaning survives under reduce. Four reduce strategies plus live preference, audit workflow, and dual-state verify harness.
